hail.text: Over here! A word about those explode-y mushrooms, if you have a moment.

greet.text: Hold a moment, Luminary. Will you help me watch for fungus? Dispatch those explode-y mushrooms near the Spire — three will do.

greet_again.text: Changed your mind? Will you help dispatch three explode-y mushrooms?

accept.text: Thank you! The Journal will keep count — come back when three are down.

decline.text: No harm done. Wave if you change your mind.

reminder.text: Still need three explode-y mushrooms. Check your Journal tracker if you lose count.

turnin.text: That's the last of them — well done! Here's a little thanks from the Spire. The Herbalist east of here may have more for you.

done.text: You've done enough mushroom hunting for one day. Safe travels!
